title: Endothelial responses in acute EAE show limited overlap with those in chronic multiple sclerosis
description:
Version 3.0.0 of the analysis and reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript “Endothelial responses in acute EAE show limited overlap with those in chronic multiple sclerosis”.

The revised comparison uses three acute EAE cohorts and two human endothelial cohorts with chronic active multiple sclerosis. All ten cohort pairs use the same 6,611 archived strict orthologues and the same effect estimator. Stratified resampling of animals and donors, subject omission analyses, endothelial subtype composition, and comparisons restricted to capillary cells are included. Eleven barrier related gene sets are assessed with explicit coverage rules and an additional comparison using shared gene symbols.

The archive contains analysis scripts, Python environment specifications, derived animal and donor expression profiles, input filenames and download URLs, numerical results for Supplementary Tables S1 to S22, five current main figures and Supplementary Figures S1 to S10. Earlier results and code are retained with clear links to the current analysis. The source studies provide the original raw sequencing matrices.

Mean agreement was 0.389 among the three mouse cohort pairs and 0.060 among the six mouse and human pairs on the common gene set. Eight focused gene sets met the strict coverage threshold. None of their 40 tests was significant after correction for the false discovery rate. The archive records all 2,000 resampling attempts, including 1,841 estimable attempts, and treats their percentile ranges as descriptive summaries of the selected cohorts.
